## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: strong sector breadth plus mixed risk signals — VXX (1W: -14.03% | 1M: +8.00%) CORRECTION ↓ falling and HYG (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +0.01%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit conditions modestly constructive: HYG (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +0.01%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising vs LQD (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -1.02%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. Volatility shows a short-term unwind and longer-term residue: VXX (1W: -14.03% | 1M: +8.00%) CORRECTION ↓ falling. Commodity-led impulse centered on oil: USO (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +44.26%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and BNO (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +35.86%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: UUP (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.27%) CORRECTION ↓ falling shows a mixed dollar, while TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: -2.02%) RECOVERY ↑ rising signals no decisive move in yields.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Broad risk-on internals but energy is the outlier: XLK (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -2.30%) RECOVERY ↑ rising, XLF (1W: +5.22% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY ↑ rising, XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION ↓ falling. Style: Growth/momentum showing strength, confirmed by 10/11 breadth.

5. US vs Global?
US equities recovering: SPY (1W: +3.92% | 1M: -3.02%) RECOVERY ↑ rising, QQQ (1W: +4.61% | 1M: -3.23%) RECOVERY ↑ rising; EM also bouncing: EEM (1W: +3.46% | 1M: -0.90%) RECOVERY ↑ rising and FXI (1W: +2.01% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY ↑ rising — US still modestly ahead.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative vehicles showing short-term bounces but 1M weakness: ARKK (1W: +6.45% | 1M: -7.01%) RECOVERY ↑ rising, IWM (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -1.54%) RECOVERY ↑ rising, IBIT (1W: +5.67% | 1M: -2.15%) RECOVERY ↑ rising — appetite returning but with month-framed caution.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity strength led by oil: USO (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +44.26%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, BNO (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +35.86%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; copper CPER (1W: +2.54% | 1M: -3.60%) RECOVERY ↑ rising and precious metals GLD (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -8.26%) RECOVERY ↑ rising show mixed cyclic impulses.

8. Energy Trend?
Commodity/equity divergence in energy: XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION ↓ falling while underlying oil ETFs USO (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +44.26%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising; natural gas UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and remains weak.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: very broad sector breadth (10/11) and risk proxies showing mixed signals (HYG ABOVE TREND and VXX CORRECTION). Major divergence flagged — SPY, XLK and TLT all show 1W/1M mismatches (RECOVERY), indicating MAJOR DIVERGENCE and a transitional market.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor selective risk exposures showing momentum: XLK (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -2.30%) RECOVERY ↑ rising, XBI (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, XLF (1W: +5.22% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY ↑ rising; reduce exposure to energy equities XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION ↓ falling and to UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +5.28% | 1M: -2.30%) RECOVERY ↑ rising, XBI (1W: +7.70% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, XLF (1W: +5.22% | 1M: -0.76%) RECOVERY ↑ rising. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -4.60% | 1M: +6.36%) CORRECTION ↓ falling, UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: USO (1W: +11.87% | 1M: +44.26%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, BNO (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +35.86%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -5.64%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; monitor GLD (1W: +3.12% | 1M: -8.26%) RECOVERY ↑ rising for follow-through.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (short-term complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit-health watch), XLK/XLF spread (leadership pivot) — monitor for shifts that flip the current NEUTRAL stance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive supports a constructive but non-committal market. XLK, XBI and XLF showing relative strength while energy equities and UNG show the primary divergence to monitor.
